principles: define canonical identities independently of every pre-existing HiRoute identifier
separate model identity, access product, endpoint binding, dynamic route, and evidence
never collapse product, region, entitlement, or protocol differences into global model facts
preserve unknown, conflict, conditional, runtime-required, and excluded states without placeholder values
derive metadata usability from field completeness and scenario requirements; provenance is for audit and conflict handling, not record tiers
use first-party or authenticated evidence for publishable facts
map eligible facts once into the current canonical contract selected by issue #96; do not implement legacy migration

encoding_rules: a non-null token count without an explicit state is exact for the scope named by its record
a null token count always carries an explicit unknown, runtime-required, or shared-total-budget state
product-specific token variants belong to endpoint bindings and never become one global execution limit
dynamic routes never receive a canonical rated-model identity
pricing belongs to a product and model binding; decimal rates are strings and conditional schedules remain explicit
accepted legacy aliases retain their own lifecycle and replacement relation on endpoint bindings
provider and model metadata records derive usable_for solely from field completeness and scenario requirements; provenance never lowers otherwise sufficient fields
runtime execution still requires endpoint qualification because descriptive completeness does not prove operational availability
published field evidence records an authority, collection date, and content digest when bytes are captured

every provider-scoped metadata field is closed to a determinate outcome: an observed fact, a conservative inference recorded per field as basis=inferred with its rule_key, or an explicit unsupported/not-applicable outcome; indeterminate values do not survive closure
an inferred value is never presented as an observed assertion: each inference rule cites official or family evidence, and its per-field application stays inspectable through field_provenance

data_quality_decisions.subject: Exact Coding/Token/PAYG model inventory varies by product, region, and account
data_quality_decisions.decision: Resolve per product, region, and account at runtime.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Qwen3-Coder-Next thinking support differs between Coding Plan FAQ and general model table
data_quality_decisions.decision: Keep endpoint reasoning conflict until product-authenticated metadata resolves it.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Hermes Agent and OpenClaw provide provider/model fields with uneven completeness across usage scenarios
data_quality_decisions.decision: Materialize unified provider-scoped metadata records, derive each completeness domain and usable_for scenario from the fields present, and retain exact-commit provenance only for audit, conflict handling, and refresh.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Azure, Vertex, and Bedrock resource, project, region, deployment, and model availability are account-specific
data_quality_decisions.decision: Store product and endpoint templates statically, but create no executable binding until authenticated inventory resolves the target environment.

data_quality_decisions.subject: The client scans exposed that one DeepSeek V4 family record collapsed two served model versions, legacy routing aliases, different vision capability, and time-window pricing
data_quality_decisions.decision: Split V4.1 Flash and V4 Pro 0813 identities, retain accepted legacy aliases on endpoint bindings with lifecycle/replacement metadata, and encode peak/off-peak rates as product-scoped schedules.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Provider-scoped metadata records must not terminate in uncollected unknown fields
data_quality_decisions.decision: Close every closable field to a determinate outcome: an observed fact, a conservative inference with basis=inferred and a resolvable rule key, or an explicit unsupported/not-applicable state. Inference is never presented as provider-verified, and closing a field grants no execution eligibility.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Hard context/output caps and exact deployment identity were not confirmed
data_quality_decisions.decision: Require official model card plus target deployment inventory.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Z.ai international API facts are now official, but China and Coding Plan eligibility cannot be inferred from them
data_quality_decisions.decision: Separate international, China, and Coding Plan endpoint capabilities.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Provider documents no independent text output limit
data_quality_decisions.decision: Represent the limit as shared-total-budget under the exact total context budget.

data_quality_decisions.subject: 32768 is documented as a default max_tokens value, not a hard maximum
data_quality_decisions.decision: Do not store the documented default as a hard limit. Close the record to a conservative documented output bound (65,536) labeled as an inferred fact, and keep any exact per-plan maximum a runtime fact.

data_quality_decisions.subject: K3 1M context and output limits depend on Kimi Code plan
data_quality_decisions.decision: One model identity with entitlement-dependent endpoint capabilities.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Current first-party Kimi Platform docs did not confirm the repository's general /anthropic/v1/messages path
data_quality_decisions.decision: Do not register the unsupported Platform Messages endpoint.

data_quality_decisions.subject: M3 appears in Token Plan marketing but current API docs/models evidence remains M2.7
data_quality_decisions.decision: Exclude from first release until first-party API identity exists.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Small 4 and Large 3 public model pages did not establish a separate hard max output value
data_quality_decisions.decision: Represent no independent output cap as shared-total-budget with an exact total.

data_quality_decisions.subject: openrouter/free and provider routing are dynamic and cannot be assigned a stable model identity/rating
data_quality_decisions.decision: Represent as a dynamic route record, never as a canonical rated model.

data_quality_decisions.subject: ChatGPT/Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini Code Assist subscriptions are product logins, not public general-purpose API contracts
data_quality_decisions.decision: Use only supported product integrations; do not infer private API endpoints.

data_quality_decisions.subject: Public product pages now establish hy3, hy3-202608, hy3-preview, and hy4-preview IDs, while account availability and per-protocol eligibility remain product-specific
data_quality_decisions.decision: Seed documented product bindings and alias lifecycle, but require authenticated inventory and protocol qualification before execution.

data_quality_decisions.decision: Do not register a conflicting destination.

Qwen 3.6 follows the documented 1,000,000-token / 65,536-output Qwen3 API surface with multimodal input.
Qwen 3.7 Plus follows the documented 1,000,000-token / 65,536-output Qwen3 API surface with image input.
Qwen 3.7 Max is documented with a 1,000,000-token window and 65,536 max output; the text-only variant keeps text input.
Qwen 3.8 Max is documented with a 1,000,000-token window, 131,072 max output, multimodal input, and reasoning_effort low/medium/xhigh.
Bailian documents conflicting thinking support for qwen3-coder-next; the conflict is preserved as a determinate conditional capability instead of a guessed boolean.
The Qwen3 Coder line is a text-only coding surface with a 262,144-token window and 65,536 max output.
The earlier Qwen3 open models are text-only with a conservative 131,072-token window.
The Qwen3 thinking open models support reasoning with the conservative 131,072-token window.
Qwen3-VL variants accept image input with the conservative Qwen3 open-model window.
Step 3.7 Flash is observed with a 262,144-token window and shared output budget with image input.
Step 3.5 is observed with a 262,144-token window and 65,536 max output.
Hunyuan Hy3 is documented with a 256,000-token window, 192,000 input / 128,000 output, and none/low/high reasoning.
Hunyuan Hy4 preview is documented with a 1,024,000-token window and 64,000 max output.
Upstage Solar keeps the conservative 131,072-token window and 8,192 output bound from its platform documentation.
Venice Uncensored is observed with a 128,000-token window and 8,192 output bound; no reasoning ladder is documented.
Grok 4.20 reasoning variants are documented with a 1,000,000-token window and 30,000 max output; the non-reasoning variant is covered by its own rule.
Grok 4.3 is documented with a 1,000,000-token window and 64,000 max output.
Grok 4.6 documents a 500,000-token window without a separate textual output cap, so max output stays a shared total budget; reasoning effort is always on.
The Grok coding variants follow the conservative xAI coding surface: 256,000 context and 64,000 max output with effort control.
Unspecified Grok variants fall back to the conservative pre-4.3 xAI surface: 131,072 context and 16,384 max output.
The non-reasoning Grok variant exposes no thinking control; limits follow the Grok 4.20 surface.
MiMo V2.5 / Omni records are observed with a 1,048,576-token window and 131,072 max output with image input.
The MiMo V2 code line is observed with a 1,048,576-token window and text-first input.
The earlier GLM-4 line is text-only with a 131,072-token window and 8,192 max output.
The GLM-4.5/4.6/4.7 line is documented with a 202,752-token window, reasoning effort control, and text input.
The base GLM-5 line is documented with a 202,752-token window and conservative 16,384 max output.
GLM-5.1 is the superseded previous generation with a 200,000-token window and conservative 16,384 max output.
GLM-5.2 is documented with a 1,000,000-token window and 131,072 max output; the maintained evidence lists high/max thinking.
GLM-5.3 Flash is documented with a 1,000,000-token window, 131,072 max output, and image input (the Flash variant carries vision).
GLM-5.3 is documented with a 1,000,000-token window, 131,072 max output, forced thinking with low/high/max, and text input.
GLM-5V Turbo is the vision variant with a 200,000-token window and 131,072 max output.
